avis.titre: Don't fall for the slick commercials.
avis.texte: Okay, I'm going to admit it. I am way too old to believe in skincare miracles. But what got me was how great they did on the video/commercial. It probably only took them a day with the help of AI to make the really cute video sing-song story of a woman who was left by her husband and got revenge by using a quasi mask...and she looked so good that he couldn't keep his eyes off of her! Okay there's a reason why they use cartoon women instead of a video with actual women in it. First, it's super cheap to use AI. Second, you can make that cartoon woman look so amazing after her night with her quasi mask...lol. And, although I had almost zero faith that it was going to come anywhere near how the commercial hyped it to work, I ordered it anyway simply because I just wanted to give them a kudos for that great commercial. But, when it comes to the product, you need to hear reality. It's no different than anything else that you put on your skin; matter of fact, I have received phenomenal results just using silicone scar sheets. Silicone scar sheets will temporarily remove wrinkles. I wore my quasi mask and followed the directions to a T and waited until it turned clear before removing it after about 2 to 3 hours. I use the extra leftover solution that was in the package and applied it, but when I woke up in the morning, hey guess what? I look just like I did before I went to bed...lol... it's just that I had 40 less dollars in the bank. I still have three more masks to go and they are

avis.titre: Very Happy with the results I have always wanted!
avis.texte: Amazing ! I saw results right away, and I bought more. I use them 2 times a week as directed and I am finally happy with the way my skin looks. I am 51 with medium to fine lines and winkles around my eyes and mouth （marionette lines） and lines between my brows （theses are the most stubborn for me ). Application is very easy and the mask begins to sit comfortably on your face after about 5 minutes, after that it stays put. I use the eye extra pieces for my neck, and i keep the mouthpiece where it us and use that for my lips. I have slept in the mask, its durable and it stays put till I take it off in the morning completely clear, my skin is glowing after i take it off, all I need is my daily tinted moisturizer. I am starting to see wrinkles become smoother, my poor's on my chin have shrunken, and my dark sports have lightened up a good bit. It's only been a few weeks of using these masks. I feel amazing, and moisturized!

I absolutely recommend them; they truly are hydrating. I use one every week, and I'm sure they can be used more often, but believe me, they leave your face smooth, shiny, and help with those wrinkles. I had no irritation and no redness, and the price is reasonable, but in my opinion, it could be a little less. They are also very easy to use.

Guess I’m either too old (56) or something else but while I like this product I don’t see the hype. I have used it twice. I kept it on for 3 hours. It does help with some lines. The deeper the lines the less noticeable treatment. Finer lines it worked great. The effects last 3-4 days then things go back to the natural you. The one thing that bugged me was the results next to the nose. It did plump up my skin where there are no lines, like the cheeks and next to nose area. My dislike was then it gave a slightly puffy appearance. I prefer not having a puffy face. After removing the mask I still felt the need for extra serum. Yes I added serum before applying mask too. All in all I would not purchase again. For the cost it’s not worth it for me.

avis.titre: Skin is so soft and bright after using!
avis.texte: This mask is the BEST I have ever tried!!! It takes a few hours for it to turn clear and the collagen to adhere to your skin but so worth it! Lines are diminished and skin is so soft and plump! These masks will be a staple for my skin!

Like this product. a little expensive but works good. Face feels refreshing after use. I leave it on for only two hours only. and only do it once a week due to that my face feel hydrated all week. when working outside I will try to do it twice a week. Do recommend

avis.titre: Absolutely great product. I had great results.
avis.texte: Absolutely a great product. Make sure you get the 40 not the 30. I tried this product and it really works. Keep in mind you need to be laying down after you put this product on your face. Let the fan blow on it help it stick to their face well don’t forget to use all the ingredients and the residue is inside the package. Keep this in a cool place or it’s not getting hot or moisture. Make sure that you clean your face well and apply just cleaning products no lotion nothing put this on and let it sit. It is very soothing. It’s very cool and hydrate your skin really well. I love the results of this. This is my second purchase. I guarantee you’ll love it you’ll see instant results if you use the right product make sure you get the 40 that is key. Make sure you wash your face that is very important and make sure you’re lying down the minute. You put it on it slips off and overlays make sure you use the under eye patches put them on first and then apply the top portion first in the bottom portion last we will see results very next day. I found it key to put that fan blowing on your in your face so that it can cool and dry faster.

avis.titre: Your skin will feel so niceYour skin will feel so nice
avis.texte: Wow, I love the NLQ Intensive Collagen Deep mask. My skin feels wonderful and refreshed. It took me a moment to figure out the way the masks are packed inside of the envelope and to get them (2 pieces) on my face but they instantly feel soothing and cool. My husband always comments how nice my skin looks now. I am 72 years old and I will keep buying this product. You get 5 sheets in each package.

I really did not think this product would work. I tried everything for my neck and my hooded eyes and nothing helps. I was excited to get mask. Before I went to bed, I put it on and I wore it for just over two hours which freaked my dogs out that was funny. The big difference I’ve noticed on the first one is my neck that’s always bothered me. It also helped with my hooded eyes. I love this product. My skin feels rejuvenated definitely will be using this product again.

avis.titre: Give it time but it’s good
avis.texte: So one thing I noticed with this mask is it does do what it says. However, be sure to lay down to allow gravity to help the mask adhere to your face. It takes about 20-30 minutes for this to settle. Then set your timer for about 2-3hrs. You will start to feel it absorb into the skin and there is a slight tingle. I’d say take a nap and see what it does during that time. Let it absorb completely.

AMAZING RESULTS FIRT TIME FOR A GUY!!! I am in my late 50’s and trying to look a little younger , healthier and just full of life. I bought thinking what the heck. FINALY had time while working late at home online and WOW!!! I hate I didn’t do this the minute they arrived!!! Again, this is the first time. I have already shared with tons of friends sending them the pics and Amazon link! YES, I will get more!!!

I was so excited to take it off the next day. I woke up with hard lines that weren’t there before. Even after my shower I had hard lines. This is not the answer, I think it’s another ploy. Posted one side of face effected negatively with hard lines, other side-normal/not noticeable improvement. Another bad part, gave my friend a mask as a gift.
So far, I give it a 3. It's not staying in my face and keeps peeling off
It's ok for people who don't break out or itchy not easy to put on
Definitely need to be laying down. It stayed on just fine and it started soaking in about 21/2 hours later When it all absorbed it it was amazing I give it a 10 if I could ! 5 star for sure

The first three I ordered were great. I have a picture of what the last six I have ordered look like. They formed your face this way and create wrinkles that you didn’t have there. I just put one on and took a picture. I’m trying to figure out how to get it to you. Your skin wrinkles where the wrinkles are on the mask.

avis.titre: Gives a dewy, not glass look finish. Hydrating. Takes a while to adhere to your face.
avis.texte: This mask took a long time to stick to my face, I had to lay down for about 20 minutes for it to adhere. It took about an hour before parts started turning clear. I left the mask on for a total of 3 hours. I wish I could give it the 5 stars, but I didn't get that "glass" glow they showed on all the ads. My skin WAS very hydrated, soft, and looked a bit tighter. Overall a good face mask with befits, however my face did not look like glass.

avis.titre: Seems to work well but idk haha
avis.texte: I mean, so far so good? I had it on for 3.5 hours and used the mouth/eye hole slots under my eyes and on my saggy chin. My face feels clean and tighter for sure. I tried to take photos throughout the process at different times. Some spots never dried due to overlapping the mask. I have sensitive skin and redness. I washed my face with water and used a Korean toner for redness beforehand. I’m pumped to use it again during the day to see if there is more visual changes. 24 hour update - my skin is shiny and def feels tighter!

Used these for two weeks in a row, they work great. Just need to lie down after you out it on so it molds to your skin quickly. It took about 3 hours for it to be completely clear. My skin was very soft afterwards.
Love the feel in my face and my skin is brighter. Kept the mask for 3 hours it is recommended for 2 hrs. I am over 40, with big pores, but after using this mask notice smaller pores.
Love my mask- I always feel refreshed after hydrating. I now make it a regular part of my regiment before a special occasion or at least every other week before bed.

I couldn’t wait to get this open and use it, obviously I am in much need of some self care!! I put this on, using the eye hole pieces and mouth for my neck area. I did a little laundry and picking up of my home while the mask stayed put. It comes very nicely packaged a tad oversized for my face BUT I left it on for several hours until it becomes clear as the instructions say, but when I took it off, the FIRST thing I noticed was the “smoker” lines above my top lip looked like I’d had fillers, I could NOT believe my eyes. My skin felt like a baby’s butt, I was plumped up a bit and it really does WORK!!! It simply WORKED for me!!! I’m so glad I got two packages of this, as I will be using it religiously!! Buy it now and FOLLOW the instructions and I hope you get the results I did!! I looked this morning and my “smoker” lines are STILL gone!!! It worked for me and will be purchasing more before my 2 packages of 4 get used up!!!

avis.titre: Max hydration with a couple caveats
avis.texte: High level skin care! These masks offer fantastic hydration that lasts. They come in 2 pieces for a totally customizable fit. They have minimal fragrance which I definitely appreciate since it needs to be on your face for an hour. That time is a bit of a hangup though. It doesn't seem to matter how well I clean and dry my face, they slip and slide down my face. I have resorted to using a reusable silicone mask holder on top for maximum effectiveness! It keeps these delicate, easily torn collagen masks in place for the most part, and helps allow the total absorption of the product for top skin care. Careful with longer nails as the masks can tear easily. I do recommend these super beneficialand effective masks, even at this higher price point, just have something to keep them in place if you don't have time to lay still for an entire hour.

Is it a nice mask? Yes. Is it a miracle worker? No more than all the others. This is a nice feeling mask; somewhat slick and not paper feeling, but it is delicate, and I have issues getting it on my face properly without wasting all the product on my hands while applying it. This doesn't make me break out, and the product itself doesn't have a bad scent. I can't say it is better than the cheaper paper kind, but it does feel more luxurious, so if it is a gift for someone difficult to buy for, who you know will go and look at how much you spent on them, this is a good option. (If you know, you know) For myself, I do like this better than paper, but the price is my biggest hurdle. The product does absorb well and makes my skin happy, but I'm not sure it makes it around $10 a mask happy. I could see reordering if I'm having a "spa" day with sisters and want to make everyone feel pampered, and the "turns clear" is a spiffy feature. For just myself, though, I can't justify the cost daily, so these would be a special occasion treat. This does recommend daily use, but I can't justify $300 a month (on average) for face masks.

avis.titre: Gets the job done; enjoy the mask texture
avis.texte: This face mask comes with two pieces for a better “custom” fit. I have a small face and therefore the top and bottom pieces overlap a bit, but I don’t mind. The mask stays on my face well, even if sitting upright, so that I can still do a few light chores (or watch tv!) while wearing it. The mask itself had a sufficient amount of product but wasn’t overly drenched in it; there was no excess to rub on other parts of my body or even into my skin after the allotted time I used the mask. My skin felt refreshed and a bit bouncier, but I didn’t necessarily notice any life changing results. A fun product for a little pick me up pampering time with a comfortable texture to comfort your skin.

avis.titre: Unique Jelly Texture That Actually Delivers Results
avis.texte: I expected traditional sheet masks, but these turned out to be gel-based masks with a jelly-like texture—almost like cool coconut jelly for your face. Each mask comes in two pieces (top and bottom halves), which makes it easy to fit snugly around facial contours. The sensation is cooling and soothing, and I even used the leftover serum on my neck and chest so none went to waste. The packaging claims you can leave it on overnight, which would probably be great for back sleepers, but as a side/stomach sleeper, I had to remove it after a while. Still, I woke up with hydrated, plump, and noticeably smoother skin the next morning. The mask changes color as it dries—going from translucent jelly to almost clear—which helps signal when it’s done. Once removed, my skin felt soft and refreshed without stickiness. The price tag is high for only four masks, which makes it more of an occasional luxury treatment than a daily staple. But performance-wise, I was genuinely impressed. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ — Expensive, but delivers a visible glow and lasting hydration.

avis.titre: I love these face masks! They are incredibly hydrating
avis.texte: This is a very hydrating face mask. I don't know that I would use it overnight as it would get all over my pillow when I fell asleep but when I tried it I had some hours to sit and be still and read so I took advantage of that time to try this facemask. First, the directions say to wear it for 1.5-2 hours. I opened it up and used it for almost 2 hours. The face make is like a gel mask, saturated with the serum. As it dries on your face (it really does take hours!), it will become more transparent. It is well saturated, but the gel part really did keep it on my face without slipping off (which was something I worried about). It fit my face well and was quite comfortable to wear. I left mine on for a hour and fourty-five minutes. It was drying when I took it off but it left my face so hydrated!! I could feel the softness in my skin for days after using this. At the end, I absolutely loved using this! It did an amazing job at hydrating my face and it was kind of nice to have an excuse to sit and read for a couple of hours. So not only did I get smooth, hydrated skin, but I also made time for me to sit quietly and it was a great excuse to read. Made in Korea. This set comes with 4 masks.

These have plenty of serum in them. They aren't dry like some others I have tried. They feel soothing and leave my skin feeling plump and hydrated. They have almost no odor which I see as a huge plus. They are a bit pricey compared to similar products that deliver similar results however and for that reason I took a star off. Aside from the price point I would definitely consider purchasing these.

There is a lot of buzz about K-beauty’s “collagen quasi face mask.” These masks are not cheap, but they are worth the expense. First, I would like to point out that these masks are not like the typical cloth masks. These are gel-like masks that slide off one is moving around not sitting still. Putting the mask will take a few minutes, and once the mask is in place, one should be still and wear it for 1.5-to-2-hours. This face mask is not one to wear while taking care of chores or other tasks. I recommend wearing this mask while reading a book that will require some time or while sleeping. As for the results, if one wears the mask for the recommended time and rubs the excess essence, the user’s skin will feel moisturized and will glow. These masks will not result in a miracle, but they work so well. I had no allergic reactions, but I suggest the user to check if allergies occur. In sum, this product is expensive, but it is worth the expense.

This is made of a Jell-O like material. That’s the best way I can describe it. It is a thin sheet, that has holes cut out for your eyes, mouth, and nose. I struggled to get it out in one piece and ended up tearing it. I did place the torn pieces on my face and put it back together. It states you’re supposed to use it for an hour and a half! I did this as I was laying in bed doomscrolling. It is refreshing. It does not have a smell. I did not break out after using it.

I’m really pleased with the Quasi Bio-Collagen Face Mask. I place it on my face and adjust it for the perfect fit, smoothing any leftover mask around my chin and jawline. I like using it before bed while watching TV. This Korean overnight mask is designed to deeply hydrate and nourish the skin as I sleep. My face feels incredible afterward, and I love applying it at night so I don’t have to layer on makeup immediately. In the morning, I notice that my smile lines and forehead wrinkles appear visibly softer.

Quasi Bio-Collagen Face Mask Overnight – Hydrating Korean Sheet Mask – Niacinamide & Low Molecular Collagen – Firming & Smoothing Skincare for All Skin Types – 4 Masks. I've become an addict for masks, and K-beauty ones always excite me. I especially love collagen ones as they actually adhere well. I like having the option of being able to multi-task with a mask on. This mask was easy to apply, and definitely adhered well. It was easy to take off with no residual tackiness. My skin looked slightly moisturized, so a very solid 4.5. {I'm also a skeptic, so to actually see anything is remarkable.}

High quality hydration mask. Generous amount of product on each mask. Easy to use. Hardest part is leaving it on for 1.5-2 hours. Could take a nap or even watch some TV as it sticks well enough to your face. Skin feels super soft and fresh afterwards. Makes for a nice gift too.

Tonight I’m trying out face mask, and I’m super excited to see how it holds up. I’m a combination back and side sleeper, so this will be a real test of how well the product stays on and how my skin feels by morning. So far, the mask feels comfortable and secure, not too tight, and the material feels nice and cool against my skin. I’m hopeful it’ll stay in place. I’ll be back with an update in the morning to share how it held up and whether I notice any difference in how my skin looks or feels!

I bought these masks after seeing many ads on Instagram. I’ve used a couple of the masks and they perform as advertised. The collagen takes about 2 hours to fully penetrate the skin and make the mask clear and ready to peel off. I was left with nicely hydrated skin. I’m post-menopausal and my skin can be quite dry, but these masks have really helped with the dryness. The mask can be a bit slippery and may slide down when you first put it on, but once it starts penetrating it stays in place. I will definitely be buying more.
Designed in Korea, made in China. Great commercials, meh product. Mostly hype.

For me, fully absorbed in about 2 hours. (Pictures were at application and then 2 hours). Skin felt really nice and smooth, fine lines were smoothed out (deeper wrinkles not), but overall I liked the results of the first application.
As you can see in the photo, only the area above my upper lip has absorbed into my skin. The rest still looks wet and hasn’t really changed.

This product was horrible. I had a very bad reaction to it and it was only on my face for 5 minutes. I put some of the serum on my neck and that's when I noticed the welts starting form in about 5 minutes, so I took the whole thing off my face. My face burned, was swollen and red.
This item is worthless. I tried to put it on my face and it fell apart completely.

I did my skincare,then after my cream I applied this sheet mask. So far so good. NOT moving around on my. I listened to package and waiting for a bit before doing things. I did cut the sides of the nose to fit me better in that area. I am so looking forward to the glow.

Omg finally something that actually work im in freaking shock i didnt even have time yo leave it on before it went transparent and it worked im 45 and look like i did in my 30s hell yeah worth every penny, i will definitely be buying again
